title: SecPO: Principled Adversarial Training for Prompt Injection Security
abstract: arXiv:2610.41998v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recognized as a top threat to AI agents, prompt injection allows instructions from untrusted data (email, documents, websites) to manipulate the agent's operation. The existing best-defended LLM, Meta-SecAlign, is trained with the DPO loss but still suffers from attack success rates (ASRs) approaching 100% under adaptive prompt injections. One reason is that DPO anchors the model around the undefended reference model, which is insecure. We show an idealized reference model---an injection-invariant, utility-preserving oracle---can nevertheless be approximated, as its output distribution in training is interestingly accessible. This new observation motivates a theoretically principled SecPO loss. Another Meta-SecAlign shortcoming is that it trains on weak simulated attacks. We implement an efficient adversarial training (AT) pipeline that synthesizes strong injected inputs (best@240), and train the model on them. Our AT reduces ASRs by 1

translated_title: SecPO：面向提示注入安全的原理性对抗训练
translated_abstract: 提示注入被公认为AI智能体的头号威胁，它允许来自不可信数据（电子邮件、文档、网站）中的指令操纵智能体的运行。现有防御能力最强的LLM——Meta-SecAlign——虽然使用DPO损失进行训练，但在自适应提示注入下仍会遭受接近100%的攻击成功率（ASR）。原因之一在于DPO将模型锚定在一个未设防的参考模型上，而该参考模型本身是不安全的。我们证明，一个理想化的参考模型——即对注入不变且保持效用的预言机——仍然是可以被近似的，因为其在训练中的输出分布有趣地是可获得的。这一新发现催生了一个具有理论依据的SecPO损失。Meta-SecAlign的另一个缺点是它仅在弱模拟攻击上进行训练。我们实现了一个高效的对抗训练（AT）流水线，用于合成强注入输入（best@240），并在这些输入上训练模型。我们的对抗训练将攻击成功率降低了1（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出SecPO，一种具有理论依据的对抗训练方法，通过近似理想化的注入不变参考模型并利用强对抗注入样本进行训练，大幅降低了提示注入攻击的成功率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SecPO, a theoretically principled adversarial training method that approximates an idealized injection-invariant reference model and trains on strong synthesized adversarial injections, substantially reducing prompt injection attack success rates.
